Call for Papers

We invite research papers in computer engineering. This is a first draft and will be updated in week 3.

Theme

Scope

The theme sets the direction; the scope says which papers belong.

Track 1

System

Information systems, applications and software architecture

Track 2

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Intelligent systems, language and image processing

Track 3

Database design, data management and analytics

Track 4

Machine learning models for prediction and classification

Track 5

Internet of Things (IoT)

Connected devices, sensors and embedded systems

Track 6

Security

System, network and data security

What Fits

Papers need a technical part, such as designing, building or testing a system. Business analysis with no technical work: [under discussion by the program committee]
